fields.UserDescription: Common: Status field changed in this save
fields.UserComments: Reusable transition detector for AfterUpdate bindings on any entity with a Status column (People, Organizations). MJ ships no seed ActionFilter rows (verified 2026-08-30) — the reusable piece upstream is the ActionFilterContext vocabulary this Code uses. Two behaviours to respect when attaching it: a CREATE reports no changes (DidFieldChange is false on insert), so never attach this to an AfterCreate-only binding; and filter evaluation is fail-closed — a prevented run still writes an ActionExecutionLog row.
fields.CodeExplanation: True only when the Status field's value actually differs across this save — the binding fires on the transition, not on every update.

fields.UserDescription: Common: Status field changed to Ended in this save
fields.UserComments: The 'field changed TO value' shape — written as a transition, never as 'status IS Ended', which would re-fire on every later save of an ended record. Loose compare per the ActionFilterContext contract. Same caveats as the plain status-changed filter: false on create, fail-closed evaluation.
fields.CodeExplanation: True only on the save that moves Status to Ended, so a relationship's end is logged exactly once per transition.
